    page_limit=20

        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

            break
        matches.extend(res)

    # Exact match post-filter

    return matches, exact

# Re-login to Venmo
venmo_pw = [x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]['password']
venmo_access_token = apis.venmo.login(username='ed_wilson@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# Target payload from prior computation
share = Decimal('117.60')
target = {
    'connorbrow@gmail.com': {'amount': float(share), 'description': f"Amazon Purchases - ${share:.2f}"},
    'jepowell@gmail.com': {'amount': float(share), 'description': f"Amazon Purchases - ${share:.2f}"},
    'mar_blac@gmail.com': {'amount': float(share), 'description': f"Amazon Purchases - ${share:.2f}"},
}

print('Target payment requests:')
for email, v in target.items():
    print(email, v)

print('\nVenmo API doc update_payment_request:')
print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='venmo', api_name='update_payment_request'))

# Fetch existing sent payment requests with pagination; focus on pending
existing=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    existing.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

print('\nExisting pending sent payment requests fetched:', len(existing))

# Print any that match our target receivers
matches=[]
for pr in existing:
    recv = (pr.get('receiver') or {}).get('email')
    if recv in target:
        matches.append({
            'payment_request_id': pr.get('payment_request_id'),
            'receiver_email': recv,
            'amount': pr.get('amount'),
            'description': pr.get('description'),
            'created_at': pr.get('created_at'),
            'private': pr.get('private')
        })

print('\nMatches with target recipients (pending sent requests):', len(matches))
for m in matches:
    print(m)

# Determine actions: create for those with no exact match
exact_desc = {email: v['description'] for email, v in target.items()}
exact_amount = {email: v['amount'] for email, v in target.items()}

create_emails=[]
update_items=[]
for email in target.keys():
    cand = [m for m in matches if m['receiver_email']==email]
    exact = [m for m in cand if m['amount']==exact_amount[email] and (m['description'] or '')==exact_desc[email]]
    if exact:
        # already has exact pending request; skip
        continue
    if len(cand)==0:
        create_emails.append(email)
    else:
        # there is pending but not exact; update first one
        update_items.append(cand[0])
